title: Letter From The Netherlands Consulate-General Re B.M. Fedorenko And A.P. Fedorischeff

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 21.500-1.31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C. S. D. REGISTRY / SECTION 2 - SERON / #833 / Date September 29, 1932）

Subject (in full) Letter from the Netherlands Consulate-General re: B.M.Fedo-
renko and A.P. Fedorischeff.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by O.B.R. O.I.

With reference to the letter dated September 17,1932,
from the Netherlands Consulate-General on the subject of two
Russians named B.M.Fedorenko and A.P.Fedorischeff,particulars
on record regarding these individuals are as follows:-

1). Boris Mitrofanovitch Fedorenko,born April 2,1909,at
Omsk,Siberia. He arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok
in December 1922 in company with the Omsk Military Cadet
School contingent and later became a professional musi-
cian(drummer). In this capacity he has been working con-
tinually in both Shanghai and Hankow. He is at present
in the latter port.

2). Alexander Petrovitch Fedorischeff,born August 14,1900,
at Blagoveschensk,Siberia. In 1920 he fled from the
U.S.S.R. to Harbin. Here he resided for about eighteen
months after which he proceeded to Japan where he stayed
until September 1927,when he proceeded to Shanghai.
He is a musician (saxophonist ) by profession and was
employed at the Premier Cafe in Shanghai for some time,
after which he left for Hankow where he is at present
employed with the International Cafe.

Nothing is known in this office against these two indi-
viduals with the exception of the report that Fedorenko was for-
merly inclined to heavy drinking. It is,however, stated that he
has reformed during the past two years.

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Mr Yu, usual letter please / M / 29.9.32.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 中央秘书处档案室 / 第2科 - SERON / #833 / 日期 1932年9月29日）

事由（全称） 荷兰总领事馆关于 B.M. Fedorenko 和 A.P. Fedorischeff 的来信。

由 D.S. Prokofiev 拟稿，经 O.B.R. O.I. 转呈。

关于荷兰总领事馆 1932 年 9 月 17 日来信，提及两名名为 B.M. Fedorenko 和 A.P. Fedorischeff 的俄国人，现将档案中关于此二人的记录详情列述如下：-

1). Boris Mitrofanovitch Fedorenko，1909 年 4 月 2 日出生于西伯利亚鄂木斯克。他于 1922 年 12 月随鄂木斯克陆军士官学校分队从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海，后成为职业音乐家（鼓手）。以此身份，他一直在上海和汉口两地工作。目前他在后者（即汉口）港口。

2). Alexander Petrovitch Fedorischeff，1900 年 8 月 14 日出生于西伯利亚布拉戈维申斯克。1920 年，他从苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟逃往哈尔滨。在此居住约十八个月后，他前往日本，并停留至 1927 年 9 月，随后前往上海。他的职业是音乐家（萨克斯管手），曾在上海的首饰咖啡馆（Premier Cafe）受雇一段时间，之后前往汉口，目前受雇于国际咖啡馆（International Cafe）。

除有关 Fedorenko 过去有酗酒倾向的报告外，本处对此二人并无其他不良记录。不过，据称他在过去两年中已改过自新。

A. Prokofiev
D. S.

特别分部主管警官。

（批注：余先生，请按惯例复信 / M / 1932年9月29日。）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDER
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 2590.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. P. S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4033
Date 19 / 9 / 32

SHANGHAI 17 September 1932.

D 587

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Boris M. Fedorenko,
a musician, at present staying in Hankow, a former military
cadet, about 23 years of age, and Alexander Petrovitch
Fedorisheff, a musician, also staying in Hankow, born at
Blagovechtshensk, about 32 years of age, who arrived in
China from Japan in 1927, desire to proceed to Netherlands
India.

I would be much obliged to know whether anything is
known against these persons either from a political or a
moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Chinese Secretary.)

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

For inquiry and report
please
S.S. Moskofieff.
OSR 19/9. 19-9-32

荷兰驻华中总领事馆。
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。
第 2590 号。

上海公共租界
中央警务处档案室
第 D 4033 号
日期 19 / 9 / 32

上海，1932 年 9 月 17 日。

D 587

先生：

谨此通知阁下，音乐家 Boris M. Fedorenko，现居汉口，前陆军士官生，年龄约 23 岁；以及音乐家 Alexander Petrovitch Fedorisheff，亦居汉口，出生于布拉戈维申斯克，年龄约 32 岁，于 1927 年从日本抵达中国，二人希望前往荷属东印度。

如蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否掌握有此二人的任何不良记录，不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

（中文秘书。）

T. P. Givens 先生，
特别分部主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

请查询并报告
S.S. Moskofieff。
OSR 19/9. 19-9-32

page_data.en:
September 30 32.

Sir,

With reference to your letter No.2590
of September 17,1932, I have the honour to inform
you that there is nothing in the police records
against Boris M. Fedorenko and Alexander Petrovitch
Fedoriacheff who desire to proceed to Netherlands
India.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

1932 年 9 月 30 日。

先生：

关于阁下 1932 年 9 月 17 日第 2590 号来信，谨此通知阁下，警方档案中并无希望前往荷属东印度的 Boris M. Fedorenko 和 Alexander Petrovitch Fedoriacheff 的不良记录。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

特别分部主管警官。

荷兰驻上海总领事，
上海。
